Definition: Pedajah, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Pedaiah = "Jehovah has ransomed"; 1) father of Zebudah, the wife of king Josiah and the mother of king Jehoiakim both of Judah; 2) father of Zerubbabel and brother of Shealtiel who is usually called the father of Zerubbabel probably because of a lack of an heir from Shealtiel who was in the direct line of succession
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
